voting_definitions.plurality: Unique largest eligible exact-rational current-round vote count; ties abstain.
voting_definitions.initial_anchored: Round-zero votes plus current-round votes; round zero is counted once when r=0; tied exact scores abstain.
voting_definitions.agent_history: Each agent contributes total weight one, equally divided over its DISTINCT eligible exact-rational answers observed from round zero through r; no eligible history contributes zero; tied exact scores abstain.

stopping_definitions.high_agreement_8: First completed round 0..3 where the selected voter has a unique answer and at least eight of the ORIGINAL ten current agents support that answer; otherwise use the selected voter at round three.
stopping_definitions.stable_majority_6: First completed round r>=1 where the selected voter has the same unique answer at r-1 and r and at least six of the ORIGINAL ten agents support that answer in EACH current panel; otherwise use the selected voter at round three.
stopping_definitions.fixed_rounds: Controls stop after the specified full round 0, 1, 2, or 3 and use the selected voter at that round.
